title: Add observability query result cache and token-phase synthetic tracer
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Observability query endpoints were repeatedly executing identical, expensive aggregation queries during SLO analyses, and our token-phase timing breakdown lacked stable synthetic signals for low-volume routes. This PR introduces two complementary features: 1) a small in-memory query-result cache for the observability query service (configurable TTL + size per-tenant) to reduce duplicate work during dashboards and alert evaluation, and 2) a token-phase synthetic tracer and replay harness that emits consistent micro-timestamps for synthetic invocations so we can measure phase-level latency for init/prefix/kv/decode across models and routes. Changes are scoped to the observability backend and the tracing agent; no public API changes. Checklist: - Implement query result cache with per-tenant TTL and LRU eviction - Add cache instrumentation (hit/miss counters, eviction reasons) - Implement token-phase synthetic tracer with configurable shapes and seed prompts - Add a small synthetic-replay harness used by CI perf tests - Dashboard: add "Trace Composition Explorer" panel and a cache telemetry page - Alert tuning: add a suggestion rule to suppress noisier alerts when cache hit-rate > 90% - Unit + integration tests for cache correctness and tracer determinism - Perf bench: end-to-end synthetic runs showing ~63% reduction in repeated observability query CPU in the hot path Summary of changes: - New service: observ-query-cache with metrics observ_query_cache{tenant,reason,op}=counter - Tracer emits spans with attributes token.phase={init,prefix,kv,decode}, token.phase_ns and synthetic.invocation_id - Dashboard: trace-composition-explorer.json (Grafana panel) and cache-metrics.json - Alert rule: observability/cache-high-hitquiet.yaml (suggests suppressing low-signal alerts) - Small changes to the tracing-agent to accept synthetic replay hooks Rollout plan: feature-gated by default; can be enabled tenant-by-tenant via console. Start in canary with internal customers and a 2-week gradual rollout with metrics review at day 2/7/14. Observability: cache has a control plane metric observ_query_cache.entries and per-tenant hit_ratio gauge; tracer emits deterministic synthetic spans tagged synthetic:true for easy filtering. Performance: microbench harness shows median query CPU for repeated queries down from 120ms/core to 45ms/core (63% reduction) at 95th percentile. No functional changes to inference serving path; no user-visible API changes. Related: ENG-17422 (query noise reduction), ENG-17890 (token-phase observability).
